description: Get recent check-ins near a location (lat/lng) — what people are drinking nearby right now. Optionally widen the search radius. Read-only.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact projects each check-in to {id, user, beer, brewery, venue, rating, comment, toast/comment counts}; "full" returns Untappd's whole ~5 KB record.

name: untappd_local_checkins
title: Get nearby Untappd check-ins
